annotation.p: A classic space expedition chronicle uncovering the lost navigational network of the ancestral worlds.

epigraph.p: The stars do not whisper their secrets to those who look only at their feet.

section.p: The atmospheric dampeners hummed against the dry autumn winds of the outer rim. Commander Wayne stood before the holographic star-chart, his eyes tracing the faint pulsed coordinates.
Across the room, Lyra transcribed the sensor telemetry[1]:

stanza.v: Beneath the copper canopy of night,
An ancient signal cuts the boundless deep.
Beyond the dying embers of our light,
The silent custodians their vigil keep.

section.p: "The pulse isn't random," Wayne remarked, leaning over the obsidian terminal. "It carries the cryptographic seal of the First Empire."
Navigation prepared the jump calculations according to imperial standard tables:
With a synchronized ignition sequence, the vessel slipped beyond normal space-time into the hyper-spatial void.
Sub-etheric directional antennae tuned to the fundamental 21-centimeter interstellar hydrogen line.
